scenes.headline: Row Level Security
scenes.subtitle: Show each user only their permitted rows
scenes.narration: Row-level security filters table rows based on the querying user so people see only the records they are entitled to.

scenes.headline: What row filters do
items: Restrict visible rows by user, group, or region
Enforce tenant isolation in shared tables
Apply the same policy across all queries
scenes.narration: A row filter limits results to the rows a user is allowed to see. This is essential for multi-tenant and regional data isolation. Because the policy attaches to the table, it applies uniformly no matter how the data is queried.

scenes.headline: A row filter in Unity Catalog
scenes.code:
-- Filter function: managers see only their region
CREATE FUNCTION main.security.region_filter(region STRING)
RETURN is_account_group_member('all_regions')
     OR region = current_user_region();

-- Attach it to the table
ALTER TABLE main.sales.transactions
  SET ROW FILTER main.security.region_filter ON (region);
scenes.narration: The filter function returns true only for rows matching the user's region, or for privileged global users. Attaching it as a row filter makes every query automatically scoped. A West-region manager thus sees only West transactions.

scenes.headline: Row-level vs column-level security
scenes.narration: Row-level security decides which records a user can see at all. Column masking decides how much of a visible field is revealed. Together they give complete, fine-grained control over data exposure.

scenes.headline: Best practices
items: Keep filter logic simple for performance
Test policies with impersonation before rollout
scenes.narration: Group-driven filters remain manageable as your user base grows. Simple predicates keep the filter cheap so queries stay fast. Validating with impersonation catches mistakes before real users are affected.

scenes.text: Row filters ensure each user queries the same table but sees a personalized slice.
scenes.narration: One physical table, many secure views, all governed centrally.
